description: Department  of Animal Production & Health - Publishing the newly established Welioya D/S Division, Mullaitivu District in addition to the D/S/Ds published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1652/6 of 03.05.2010 under Sec. 19 of the Animals Act No. 29 of 1958
reasoning: This gazette notification announces the establishment of a new Divisional Secretarial Division (Welioya) in the administrative structure of Mullativu District. It involves government structural/administrative changes (creating a new administrative division) without naming any specific individuals or detailing personnel appointments. The content focuses solely on organizational restructuring of government administrative units.
